title: 第一章 寒雨藏锋人心如刃第二章 灯下谋算暗流潜行
lines: 暮秋夜雨，寒彻骨。
大靖王朝，青阳城，镇北侯府后院的演武场，早已被连绵的冷雨浸透。青石板路面光滑如镜，积着浅浅一层黑水，倒映着漫天阴沉的雨幕，也映着场中对峙的两道身影。
风声卷着雨丝呼啸而过，刮过空旷的演武台，带走了秋日最后一丝暖意，只余下彻骨的寒凉。
沈砚身着一身半旧的玄色劲装，衣料被雨水打湿，紧紧贴在脊背与肩头，勾勒出少年清瘦却极为挺拔的身形。他今年方才十五岁，褪去了孩童的稚嫩，眉眼已然轮廓分明。漆黑的长发未束整齐，几缕湿发贴在额前，遮住了些许眼眸，只露出一截线条冷硬的下颌，唇线平直，无半分少年人的跳脱鲜活。
他的双手自然垂在身侧，五指修长、骨节分明，掌心带着常年握剑练拳磨出的厚茧，即便浸在冷雨之中，也稳如磐石，没有一丝颤抖。
对面，站着侯府三房的嫡子沈浩，年十七，身形比沈砚更为魁梧，一身崭新的锦缎武服，腰间挂着精致的玉坠，衬得家世优渥、意气风发。只是此刻他眉眼间满是戾气，眼神阴鸷，死死盯着前方的沈砚，胸腔起伏剧烈，显然怒到了极致。
“沈砚，我再问你最后一次，我的玄铁短刃，是不是你偷的？”
沈浩的声音劈开雨声，粗哑凌厉，带着仗势欺人的蛮横。他身后跟着四名三房的护卫，个个腰佩长刀，身形挺拔，目光不善，隐隐呈合围之势，将沈砚困在演武场中央。
这场雨下了整整一个时辰，这场对峙，也僵持了整整一个时辰。
整个镇北侯府，谁都知道三房嫡子沈浩骄纵跋扈，仗着生母柳氏受宠，在府中横行无忌，素来欺压府中旁支子弟。而沈砚，是侯府已故大公子唯一的遗孤，父母早亡，无依无靠，自幼便在府中谨小慎微，沉默寡言，是所有人眼中最不起眼、最好拿捏的软柿子。
今日沈浩丢失了贴身修炼的玄铁短刃，不查库房、不审下人，第一时间便带人围堵了独居后院偏院的沈砚，理由荒唐又可笑——整个侯府，只有沈砚最穷，最缺趁手的兵刃，也最敢“偷窃”。
风雨更急，豆大的雨点砸在演武场上，噼啪作响。
沈砚终于抬眼。
他的眼眸很黑，是那种深不见底的墨色，没有少年被当众围堵的惊慌，没有被无端污蔑的愤怒，甚至连一丝波澜起伏都没有，沉静得像千年寒潭。雨水顺着他的眼尾滑落，分不清是雨还是泪，可他的眼底，自始至终冰冷清醒，无半分软弱。
他轻轻开口，声音清淡平稳，压过杂乱的雨声，字字清晰：“不是我。”
三个字，简短干脆，没有辩解的慌乱，没有委屈的控诉，坦荡却并不张扬。
这份过分的冷静，落在盛怒的沈浩眼中，反倒成了刻意的挑衅。
沈浩冷笑一声，往前踏出一步，脚下积水四溅，凶狠的目光死死锁住沈砚：“不是你？整个侯府的子弟，谁不是锦衣玉食、兵刃齐全？唯独你，常年一把锈剑伴身，修为停滞不前，不是你偷的，还能是谁？”
“我看你是仗着自己爹娘早死，无人管教，愈发胆大包天！今日若是不把短刃交出来，再跪地给我磕三个响头赔罪，我便废了你这一身粗浅的武功，把你扔出侯府！”
威胁直白又狠毒，毫不掩饰其中的恶意。
周围的护卫纷纷附和，眼神戏谑、轻蔑，如同看着一场注定落幕的笑话。在他们眼里，沈砚孤苦无依，无权无势，今日只能任由沈浩拿捏，毫无反抗之力。
可无人知晓，此刻沈砚平静的眼眸深处，正翻涌着层层叠叠的思绪，缜密且冰冷。
他在想，沈浩素来骄纵，却并非愚笨之人，往日虽时常欺凌自己，却从不会这般大动干戈、当众发难。今日这般不讲道理、死咬着自己偷窃，绝非一时冲动。
他在想，三夫人柳氏近日正暗中争夺府中演武堂的管控权，而自己的祖父，也就是镇北侯的老侯爷，手握演武堂最终话语权，素来公正，最厌偷盗狡诈之徒。
他在想，一旦自己被扣上偷窃的罪名，无论真假，都会被逐出演武堂，彻底失去修炼资源。柳氏便可借机发难，将罪责推给府中管教疏漏，顺势夺走演武堂的掌控权，一举两得。
至于那柄丢失的玄铁短刃，不过是一个随意捏造、完美无瑕的借口。
短短数息之间，前因后果、人心算计、利益纠葛，已然在沈砚心中梳理得清清楚楚。
他自五岁丧父、七岁丧母，便独自活在这偌大的侯府之中。锦衣玉食、仆从环绕的侯门，于他而言，从来不是家，而是一座步步惊心的牢笼。这里没有温情脉脉，只有弱肉强食的规则，只有利益交织的算计，人心叵测，步步藏刀。
十年寄人篱下的生活，让他早早褪去了所有天真烂漫。他比府中任何一个同龄人都更懂隐忍，更懂藏拙，更懂如何在暗流涌动的棋局中保全自身。
旁人只当他沉默懦弱、资质平庸，殊不知，他日日鸡鸣而起、深夜方休，苦练家传武学，十年从未间断。旁人只当他无依无靠、任人欺凌，殊不知，他早已看透侯府所有人心算计，默默布局，隐忍蛰伏，静待时机。
他腹黑、隐忍、善于筹谋，凡事三思而后行，从不做无谓之争，更不逞匹夫之勇。但他的底线从未动摇——不主动害人，却也绝不任人宰割；可隐忍蛰伏，却绝不屈辱苟活。
三观端正，心怀底线，却深谙世道险恶，精通人心博弈，这便是沈砚。
面对沈浩的步步紧逼与当众羞辱，沈砚依旧没有半分慌乱，语气平淡无波：“三哥的短刃何时丢失，最后一次佩戴是在何处，可有证人在场？若无凭无据，仅凭臆测便污蔑府中子弟，不妥。”
他语气平和，不卑不亢，句句戳中要害，没有半分少年人的冲动。
沈浩被他噎得一滞，随即怒火更盛。他本就是刻意栽赃，哪里来的证据？沈砚这番冷静诘问，反倒显得他蛮横无理、刻意找茬。
“好一张伶牙俐齿！”沈浩目露凶光，不再假意对峙，直接抬手厉喝，“看来不给你点教训，你不知天高地厚！给我拿下！”
话音落下，身后两名护卫立刻踏水而出，脚步沉稳，带着常年习武的悍然气势，一左一右，直扑沈砚。
这两名护卫皆是淬体四重的修为，在侯府护卫中算得上好手，对付一个常年被传“资质平庸”的沈砚，在众人看来，不过是手到擒来。
雨水狂暴，冲刷着演武场，风声呼啸，掩盖了细微的动静。
左侧护卫握拳直击，拳风凌厉，带着破风之声，直逼沈砚面门，招式狠辣，毫无留手，显然是想一击重创沈砚；右侧护卫俯身扫腿，专攻下盘，招式刁钻，意图直接将沈砚绊倒制服。
一刚一刁，配合默契，杀机暗藏。
看台角落，远远立着几名避雨的府中子弟，皆是各房庶出、旁支子弟。他们远远看着这场冲突，眼神各异，有同情，有幸灾乐祸，更多的是漠然旁观。
没人看好沈砚。
所有人都觉得，今日沈砚难逃一败，轻则受辱赔罪，重则被废武功，逐出侯府。
content_en:
It rains on a late autumn night and is bone-chilling.
Dajing Dynasty, Qingyang City, and the martial arts arena in the backyard of the Zhenbei Hou Mansion have long been soaked by the continuous cold rain. The bluestone pavement was as smooth as a mirror, with a shallow layer of black water accumulating on it, reflecting the gloomy rain in the sky and the two figures confronting each other in the field.
The wind roared with the raindrops, blowing across the empty martial arts stage, taking away the last trace of autumn warmth, leaving only a bone-chilling chill.
Shen Yan was wearing a half-worn black suit. The material was soaked by the rain and clung tightly to his back and shoulders, outlining the young man's thin but extremely tall figure. He is only fifteen years old this year, and his childlike innocence has faded away, and his features are already clear-cut. Her long, dark hair was not tied neatly, and a few strands of wet hair stuck to her forehead, covering some of her eyes, revealing only a cold and hard line of her jaw, and a straight lip line, without any trace of the liveliness of a young man.
His hands naturally hung at his sides, with long fingers and clear joints. The palms were covered with thick calluses worn out by years of holding swords and boxing. Even if they were immersed in the cold rain, they were as stable as a rock without a trace of trembling.
Opposite, stood Shen Hao, the legitimate son of the third room of the Hou Mansion. He was seventeen years old and taller than Shen Yan. He was dressed in a brand new brocade military uniform and had an exquisite jade pendant hanging around his waist, which reflected his noble family background and high spirits. But at this moment, his brows and eyes were full of anger, his eyes were sinister, and he was staring at Shen Yan in front of him. His chest was rising and falling violently, and he was obviously extremely angry.
"Shen Yan, let me ask you one last time, did you steal my black iron short blade?"
Shen Hao's voice cut through the sound of rain, rough and sharp, with the arrogance of bullying others. Behind him were four guards from the third room, all with long knives on their waists. They were tall and straight, with evil eyes, and they seemed to be surrounded, trapping Shen Yan in the center of the martial arts field.
It rained for a whole hour, and the confrontation lasted for a whole hour.
Everyone in the entire Zhenbei Hou Mansion knew that Shen Hao, the legitimate son of the third wife, was arrogant and domineering. He relied on his biological mother Liu to be favored and ran rampant in the manor. He had always oppressed the children of the other branches of the manor. And Shen Yan is the only orphan of the late eldest son of the Hou family. His parents died early and he is helpless. He has been cautious and taciturn in the family since he was a child. He is the most inconspicuous and easy-to-handle persimmon in everyone's eyes.
Today, Shen Hao lost the black iron short blade that he practiced personally. He did not check the warehouse or interrogate his servants. He immediately led people to surround Shen Yan, who lived alone in the backyard. The reason was absurd and ridiculous - in the entire Hou Mansion, only Shen Yan was the poorest, the most lacking of weapons, and the most daring to "steal".
The wind and rain became more intense, and big raindrops hit the martial arts field with a crackling sound.
Shen Yan finally raised his eyes.
His eyes were very dark, the color of bottomless ink. There was no panic of a young man being surrounded in public, no anger of being slandered for no reason, not even a trace of ups and downs, and he was as calm as a thousand-year cold pond. Rain slid down the end of his eyes, and he couldn't tell whether it was rain or tears, but his eyes were cold and clear from beginning to end, without any weakness.
He spoke softly, his voice was light and steady, and over the cluttered sound of rain, the words were clear: "It's not me."
Three words, short and concise, no panic of excuse, no accusation of grievance, magnanimous but not ostentatious.
This excessive calmness turned into a deliberate provocation in the eyes of the furious Shen Hao.
Shen Hao sneered, took a step forward, water splashed under his feet, and locked Shen Yan with a fierce gaze: "Not you? Who among the disciples in the entire Hou family is not well-dressed and well-equipped with weapons? You are the only one who has a rusty sword with you all the year round and your cultivation has stagnated. If you didn't steal it, who else could it be?"
"I think you are taking advantage of the fact that your parents died early and have no one to discipline you, so you are becoming more and more bold! If you don't hand over the short blade today and kneel down and kowtow three times to apologize to me today, I will destroy your rudimentary martial arts and throw you out of the Marquis' Mansion!"
The threat was blunt and vicious, with no trace of malice hidden in it.
The surrounding guards all echoed, with playful and contemptuous eyes, as if they were watching a joke that was destined to end. In their eyes, Shen Yan was helpless and powerless. Today, he could only let Shen Hao control him without any resistance.
But no one knew that in the depths of Shen Yan's calm eyes, layers of thoughts were surging, careful and cold.
He was thinking that Shen Hao had always been arrogant, but he was not stupid. Although he often bullied him in the past, he would never get into such a big fight or attack in public. Being so unreasonable today and insisting on stealing is definitely not impulsive.
He was thinking that the third wife, Liu, was secretly vying for control of the martial arts hall in the mansion recently, and his grandfather, the old marquis of Zhenbeihou, held the final say in the martial arts hall. He was always fair and hated thieves and cunning people.
He was thinking that once he was accused of stealing, no matter whether it was true or false, he would be expelled from the martial arts hall and completely lose his training resources. Mrs. Liu could then take the opportunity to launch an attack, shift the blame to the management's negligence, and seize control of the martial arts hall, killing two birds with one stone.
As for the lost black iron short blade, it was just a random and flawless excuse.
In just a few breaths, the causes and consequences, people's calculations, and entangled interests have been clearly sorted out in Shen Yan's mind.
Since he lost his father at the age of five and his mother at the age of seven, he has been living alone in this huge prince's mansion. To him, the Hou Men, surrounded by rich clothes, fine food, fine food, and servants, was never a home, but a prison where every step was startling. There is no tenderness here, only the law of the jungle and the calculation of intertwined interests. People's hearts are unpredictable and a knife is hidden at every step.
Ten years of living under the shelter of others made him lose all his innocence early on. He knows better than anyone of his age in the family how to be patient, how to hide clumsiness, and how to protect himself in the turbulent chess game.
Others only thought that he was silent and cowardly, with mediocre qualifications. However, they did not know that he rose up every day and rested late at night, practicing the martial arts passed down by his family for ten years without interruption. Others only thought that he was helpless and allowed to be bullied, but they didn't know that he had already seen through the calculations of everyone in the Hou Mansion, silently laid out the plan, and lurked patiently, waiting for the opportunity.
He is sinister, tolerant, good at planning, thinks twice before taking action, never engages in unnecessary arguments, and never shows off his courage. But his bottom line has never wavered - he will not take the initiative to harm others, but he will never let others take advantage of him; he can be patient and dormant, but he will never live in humiliation.
Shen Yan has a correct outlook on life, has a bottom line in mind, but is well aware of the dangers of the world, and is proficient in the game of human hearts.
Faced with Shen Hao's pressing step by step and public humiliation, Shen Yan still did not panic at all, and said in a calm tone: "When did the third brother lose his short blade? Where was he last wearing it? Are there any witnesses present? It is inappropriate to slander the children of the mansion based on mere conjecture without evidence or evidence."
His tone was calm, neither condescending nor arrogant, and his sentences hit the mark without any teenage impulsiveness.
Shen Hao was choked by him and became even more angry. He was deliberately framed, where was the evidence? Shen Yan's calm questioning made it appear that he was arrogant and deliberately looking for trouble.
"What a sharp tongue!" Shen Hao's eyes showed a fierce look, and he no longer pretended to confront, directly raised his hand and shouted, "It seems that if I don't teach you a lesson, you don't know how high the sky is! Take it down!"
As soon as the words fell, the two guards behind him immediately stepped out of the water. With steady steps and a fierce momentum from years of martial arts practice, they rushed towards Shen Yan, one on the left and the other on the right.
Both of these two guards were at the fourth level of body tempering and were considered good among the guards of the Hou Mansion. They could easily deal with Shen Yan, who had been rumored to have "mediocre qualifications" for many years.
The rain was pouring violently, washing away the martial arts arena, and the howling wind covered up the slightest movement.
The guard on the left clenched his fist and struck directly, with a sharp wind and the sound of breaking wind, coming straight to Shen Yan's face. The moves were fierce and without mercy, obviously hoping to hit Shen Yan hard with one blow; the guard on the right leaned over and swept his legs, specializing in the lower body, with tricky moves, intending to trip Shen Yan down and subdue him directly.
One is strong and the other is cunning, they cooperate with each other tacitly, and their murderous intentions are hidden.
In the corner of the stand, standing in the distance were several children from the mansion taking shelter from the rain. They were all concubines and children from various branches of the family. They watched the conflict from a distance, with different expressions, some sympathetic, some gloating, and more often indifferent.
No one is optimistic about Shen Yan.
Everyone felt that Shen Yan would not be able to escape defeat today. He would be humiliated and make amends, or his martial arts skills would be revoked and he would be expelled from the Marquis Mansion.
title_en: Chapter 1: Cold rain hides the sharp edge and the heart is as sharp as a knife Chapter 2: Undercurrent of conspiracy under the lamp
